entities.summary: Dylan Jonathan Howell Ennis McIntyre is a Canadian-Jamaican professional basketball player for UCAM Murcia of the Spanish Liga ACB. He played college basketball for Rice, Villanova, and Oregon. Ennis has played for the Jamaican national team. He also holds Canadian and Serbian citizenship.
